d:
On their way back to base, Artoria and Irisviel met Gilles de Rais, summoned as a Caster.
"Jeanne! My Jeanne! Finally I am able to make you mine!"
"What are you talking about Caster!"
"MY JEANNE!"
Caster casted a strong hypnosis spell, rendering Artoria unable to act.
"FINALLY!!!"

He pushed her down on the car and started to fuck her like a maniac.
Caster was so distracted, that his Spiritron Dresses started to change without him noticing.
"JEANNE! JEANNE! Taking your first time like I always wanted!"
He finished inside her only to notice that there was no blood leaking from her.
"Jeanne?...My pure lady wasn't pure? No! Nooooo! NOOOOOO!"
